notes:
Migrated to the unified Fact model (SYNERGY_DESIGN.md). Real oracle: 'Whenever you scry or surveil, draw a card. (Draw after you scry or surveil.)' Forge's own real script models this as TWO separate triggered abilities (Mode$ Scry, Mode$ Surveil, both running the same TrigDraw) — kept as definition.ts's own pre-existing onScry/onSurveil triggers, unchanged. Baseline self-cast(Hand)/self-enters facts added (typeLine-anchored, same 'Creature'/'Legendary Creature' substring convention as g-raha-tia/dwarven-castle-guard). Two SINK facts, one per trigger ({event:'scry',controller:'you'} / {event:'surveil',controller:'you'}, both oracle-anchored on the respective word in 'Whenever you scry or surveil') paired with two SOURCE drawCard facts (one anchored on 'draw a card', one on the reminder text's 'Draw after you scry or surveil' — distinct annotations specifically so the two facts don't collide on factIdentity, since both are otherwise role+label-identical). Neither drawCard/sink pair carries oncePerTurn — the real oracle text has no once-per-turn cap, unlike G'raha Tia's Allagan Eye.

Real, checked, asymmetric engine support: `surveil` is fully wired (card.ts's own `kind:'surveil'` Effect, `actions.surveil`/state.ts, already exercised for real by Dreams of Laguna/fin-50 and Il Mheg Pixie) but `scry` has ZERO implementation anywhere in this engine — checked directly: interfaces.ts's own `declare function scry(player, qty): void` is a bare Forge-signature-mirror doc entry, never wired into card.ts's real Actions type or state.ts (no Effect kind, no Actions.scry, no state.scry call anywhere in the pool). This is a real, documented engine gap (not a modeling oversight) — there is no possible in-scenario action that could produce real fn:'scry' trace evidence until that machinery is built. Added a scoped verify-synergy.mjs exemption, `isMatoyaScryBroadcastWant` (w.event==='scry' && card.name==='Matoya, Archon Elder'), same 'real fact, real documented wall, zero achievable evidence' tolerance as isAuronsInspirationBroadcastPumpFact — the scry SINK fact is still modeled (a future scry-producing card should still match it once find-synergies.mjs sees one) but carries no trace evidence and never will until the engine gains a real scry action. The onSurveil sibling sink on this SAME card is NOT exempted and gets real evidence.

scenarios.ts rewritten to a real engine-piloted playthrough (cast -> enters -> a real, generic `actions.surveil(ctx.you, 1)` call — fully-wired real engine action, not fabricated — -> onSurveil fired manually -> real drawCard). Per this session's own '1 scenario, real basic function' rule, this single self-contained scenario is enough; no cross-card synergy (e.g. also casting Dreams of Laguna) required in the scenario itself. verify-synergy.mjs: 0 hard failures, 2 soft notes — 'tapForMana no fact vocabulary' (pre-existing, pool-wide mana-fact gap, not this card's concern) and 'trace has surveil with no matching declared produce' (expected: the in-scenario surveil is a generic/external action, not Matoya's own produce — Matoya is a pure SINK for it, never a SOURCE). find-synergies.mjs: real cross-card matches confirmed — Dreams of Laguna and Il Mheg Pixie (both real surveil producers already in the pool) --[surveil]--> Matoya; Matoya's own self-enters also gained the usual ~130 generic Battlefield-presence sink matches every migrated creature's baseline ETB fact picks up pool-wide. No scry-side matches exist yet (0 real scry producers anywhere in the pool), as expected.
knownGaps: No real `scry` action implemented anywhere in this engine (interfaces.ts's own `declare function scry(...)` is a bare, never-wired Forge-signature mirror — unlike `surveil`, which is fully real). The `{event:'scry'}` SINK fact on this card is genuine, oracle-anchored vocabulary but has zero achievable trace evidence until a real scry action is built; exempted in verify-synergy.mjs via `isMatoyaScryBroadcastWant`. Worth a real ENGINE_GAPS.md entry if/when a second card also needs real scry (not added there yet, scoped to this card's own progress notes per the existing per-card-gap precedent — Auron's Inspiration/Magitek Infantry's own gaps are also only documented in verify-synergy.mjs+progress.json, not ENGINE_GAPS.md).
